A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Drip Loss

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Drip Loss
data_DL <- read.csv("DL.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_DL$Mean <- as.numeric(data_DL$Mean)
data_DL$SD <- as.numeric(data_DL$SD)
data_DL$Sample <- as.numeric(data_DL$Sample)
data_DL$Age <- as.numeric(data_DL$Age)
data_DL$Weight <- as.numeric(data_DL$Weight)
data_DL$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_DL$Digestible_energy)
data_DL$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_DL$Crude_protein)
data_DL$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_DL$Crude_fat)
data_DL$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_DL$Crude_fiber)
data_DL$Ash <- as.numeric(data_DL$Ash)
data_DL$Lys <- as.numeric(data_DL$Lys)
data_DL$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_DL$Met_and_Cys)
data_DL$Thr <- as.numeric(data_DL$Thr)
data_DL$Try <- as.numeric(data_DL$Try)
data_DL$Val <- as.numeric(data_DL$Val)
data_DL$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_DL$Dry_matter)
data_DL$Ca <- as.numeric(data_DL$Ca)
data_DL$P <- as.numeric(data_DL$P)
data_DL$Na <- as.numeric(data_DL$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_DL$Position <- factor(data_DL$Position)
data_DL$Breed <- factor(data_DL$Breed)
data_DL$Class <- factor(data_DL$Class)
data_DL$Sex <- factor(data_DL$Sex)
data_DL$Region <- factor(data_DL$Region)
data_DL$Aim <- factor(data_DL$Aim)
data_DL$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_DL$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_DL$rVar <- (data_DL$SD/sqrt(data_DL$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_DL_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_DL, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_DL_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_DL, method = "ML")
summary(null_DL_mod) #2588.9462            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 682; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1291.4731   3582.5491   2588.9462   2602.5213   2588.9816   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.5985  0.7736    682     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  4.0608  2.0151    349     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 681) = 3626976.1074, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   3.3828  0.1156  29.2522  <.0001  3.1561  3.6094  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_DL_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_DL, method = "ML")
summary(Re_DL_mod) #2511.7055               
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 682; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc

## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.5199  0.7210    682     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.7437  1.6564    349     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  2.4059  1.5511     57     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 681) = 3626976.1074, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
DL_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_DL, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(DL_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(DL_full_mod,null_DL_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik      LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    237 2475.5394 3547.9714 2729.6205 -1000.7697                  121712.5373 
## Reduced   3 2588.9462 2602.5213 2588.9816 -1291.4731 581.4069 <.0001 3626976.1074
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
DL_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_DL, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(DL_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(DL_Position_mod,null_DL_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    12 2580.7671 2635.0674 2581.2334 -1278.3835                1915354.8539 
## Reduced  3 2588.9462 2602.5213 2588.9816 -1291.4731 26.1792 0.0019 3626976.1074
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
DL_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Breed,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_DL, method = "ML")
R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(DL_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(DL_Breed_mod,null_DL_mod)

## Reduced   3 2588.9462 2602.5213 2588.9816 -1291.4731 341.7515 <.0001 3626976.1074
## Model with Region as a fixed effect
DL_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Region,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(DL_Region_mod)*100, 2)
anova(DL_Region_mod,null_DL_mod)
##

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
DL_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Class,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_DL, method = "ML")
R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(DL_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(DL_Class_mod,null_DL_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    20 2564.2304 2654.7310 2565.5012 -1262.1152                3550840.2402 
## Reduced  3 2588.9462 2602.5213 2588.9816 -1291.4731 58.7158 <.0001 3626976.1074
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region",
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1],
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_DL_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,  
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      ~1 |Position), 
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_DL, method = "REML")
summary(REML_DL_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 682; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1233.6468   2467.2936   2479.2936   2506.4350   2479.4182   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.3636  0.6030    682     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.7158  1.6480    349     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  2.3293  1.5262     57     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2848  0.5337    174     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  0.2473  0.4973     10     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 681) = 3626976.1074, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   3.3825  0.3243  10.4299  <.0001  2.7469  4.0182  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_DL_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID   I2_Region    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##      100.00        6.12       45.71       39.21        4.79        4.16
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_DL_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          93.88
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_DL <- orchard_plot(REML_DL_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Drip Loss (%)", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_DL)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_DL_B3 <- data_DL %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_DL_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_DL_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region,  
                               ~1 |Position) 

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_DL_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_DL_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 464; method: REML)
##

res_DL_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_DL_B3,

  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_DL_Cl <- data_DL %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Class data
VCV_DL_Cl_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_DL_Cl, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_class <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region,  
                               ~1 |Breed,
                               ~1 |Position)
  
# Model with intercept
Cl_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_DL_Cl_Data,
  mods = ~ Class,
  random = random_structure_class,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_DL_Cl)
summary(Cl_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 661; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1187.8818   2375.7636   2395.7636   2440.6252   2396.1047   
## 
## Variance Components:

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_DL_Age <- data_DL[complete.cases(data_DL$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_DL_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_DL_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,  
                                    ~1 |Breed, 
                                    ~1 |Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_DL_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_DL_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_DL_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Drip Loss (%)" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_DL_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_DL_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_DL_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_DL_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

## Run meta-regression for Crude fiber
res_DL_Cfiber <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_DL_Cfiber,          
  mod_var     = "Crude_fiber",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_DL_Cfiber",              
  x_lab       = "Crude fiber (% of DM)", 
  y_lab       = "Drip Loss (%)" 
)

## Generate summary table for Crude fiber models

aic_tab_cfiber   <- res_DL_Cfiber$aic_table                     

tbl_DL_Cfiber <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_cfiber, aic_tab_cfiber, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Crude fiber models
html_table_cfiber <- tbl_DL_Cfiber %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed, 
                            ~1 |Position)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_DL)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 682; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1231.1032   2462.2063   2476.2063   2507.8610   2476.3730   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.3630  0.6025    682     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.7162  1.6481    349     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  2.3298  1.5264     57     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2861  0.5349    174     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  0.2450  0.4950     10     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 680) = 1549648.8252, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 680) = 1.1233, p-val = 0.2896
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate       se     tval   df    pval      ci.lb    ci.ub    
## intrcpt  -75.8445  74.7544  -1.0146  680  0.3107  -222.6217  70.9327    
## Years      0.0392   0.0370   1.0598  680  0.2896    -0.0335   0.1119    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.23          93.90
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_DL <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Drip Loss (%)", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_DL <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_DL + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_DL)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure
random_structure_aim <- list(~1 |RowID,
                             ~1 |StudyID,
                             ~1 |Region,  
                             ~1 |Breed,
                             ~1 |Position)

#Model with intercept
Ai_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_DL)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 682; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1230.3036   2460.6072   2474.6072   2506.2618   2474.7739   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.3629  0.6024    682     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.7018  1.6437    349     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  2.3405  1.5299     57     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2844  0.5333    174     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  0.2503  0.5003     10     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 680) = 3028565.8920, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 680) = 2.6702, p-val = 0.1027
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se    tval   df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub      
## intrcpt    3.0126  0.3961  7.6064  680  <.0001   2.2349  3.7902  *** 
## AimYes     0.4941  0.3024  1.6341  680  0.1027  -0.0996  1.0877      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ai_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.58          93.93
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_DL_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_DL)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_DL <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_DL_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Drip Loss (%)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_DL)

4.3 Multiple_breeds (Whether multiple breeds were involved)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Mu <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed,
                            ~1 |Position)

#Model with intercept
Mu_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_DL_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds,
   random = random_structure_Mu, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_DL)
summary(Mu_VCV_REML_DL_mod_int)
